name: HiBob
description: HiBob (Bob) is an all-in-one HR platform covering core HR record-keeping, hiring and onboarding, performance management, compensation and workforce planning, and payroll for US and UK employees, aimed at mid-market and enterprise organizations with employees spread across multiple countries.
best_for: Mid-market and enterprise companies with employees across multiple countries that want a single HR system covering core HR, talent, compensation/workforce planning, and analytics, with US and UK payroll built in.
features: Core HR record-keeping with employee self-service portal, org charts, and document hub with eSignature
US and UK payroll processing plus time and attendance tracking
Compensation cycle management with pay band customization and workforce planning scenarios
Finance module with dashboards and metrics for headcount forecasting and scenario planning
"Your Voice" anonymous reporting and employee engagement surveys
Embedded AI for generating performance reviews, job descriptions, and natural-language workforce data queries
Multi-language support including English, German, Spanish, Hebrew, Dutch, and Swedish
pros: Combines core HR, talent, compensation/workforce planning, and a dedicated finance/analytics module in one platform
SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certified, with reports available under NDA
Native iOS and Android apps in addition to the web platform
cons: No self-serve pricing is published; the pricing page routes to a demo-request form rather than listing plans or a free trial
Native payroll processing is limited to the US and UK, so employees in other countries need a separate or third-party payroll solution

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: A modular workforce platform unifying HR, global payroll, IT device management, and spend management on one employee record.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting to add IT and finance modules to a global HR platform rather than a talent- and compensation-focused HRIS.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: An HRIS for small and mid-sized businesses covering employee records, hiring/onboarding, performance, and U.S. payroll as an add-on.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller businesses that want a simpler U.S.-focused HRIS with published per-employee pricing rather than a quote-based global platform.

alternatives.name: Deel
alternatives.description: A global payroll and compliance platform for hiring and paying international contractors and employees.
alternatives.best_for: Companies whose primary need is compliant global contractor/EOR payments rather than a combined HR, talent, and compensation-planning suite.
